data.one_liner: Framework-agnostic Dart SDK for the A2UI protocol supporting messages, data binding, and state models.
data.what_it_does: Provides protocol message parsing and validation, reactive state management using preact_signals, basic catalogs with validation and formatting functions, reactive component tree resolution, and bidirectional RPC coordination.
use_when: You are building Dart or Flutter clients that render the A2UI protocol.
You need reactive state management and data binding for A2UI components.
You require message parsing and validation for A2UI v0.9, v0.9.1, and v1.0 envelopes.
avoid_when: You are not using the A2UI protocol in your application.
You need legacy A2UI v0.8 payload runtime processing.
strengths: Supports multiple versions of the A2UI protocol (v0.9, v0.9.1, v1.0).
Built-in reactive state management with preact_signals.
Comprehensive JSON Schema validation and bidirectional RPC handling.
weaknesses: Strictly tied to the A2UI protocol specification.
Legacy v0.8 payloads are not supported.
